title: 第2107章 留人间一方净土万妖之乱第2106章 范阳老人铁券密经
content_zh:
顾余生心神剧震，但他极力地克制着内心，将所有内容记住后，把铁券很寻常地还了回去。
顾余生本想还要问一些什么，但话到嘴边又止住，他不过是匆匆过客，万一给这个小村子带来灾祸，就不好了。
不过既然得到了这么大的机缘，他也要有所表示，吃完饭后，顾余生道：“老人家，夜路难行，恐怕还要叨扰一晚。”
“小友不嫌寒酸，放心住下便是。”
听说顾余生要留宿，几个女人忙着回去，商量着怎么收拾一间屋子给顾余生住，顾余生围着火塘，闲聊一些关于青萍州的民间事，偶尔也和其他人交流一下怎么种庄稼，并把他和莫晚云在洗心村时学会的时令谷法教给这些人，至于他们能够听进去多少，就要看他们的机缘了。
通过闲聊，顾余生也才知道，在大荒深处并非没有人族居住生存，而是在漫长的岁月里化整为零，像他们这样几族之人栖居在相对安全之地，男耕女织，狩猎为生。
夜渐深，女人们带着孩子离去，身强体壮的男人们还在对外面的世界很好奇，顾余生几次都差点忍不住告知自己修行者身份的事实，却都被老人以眼神制止。
直至男人们也被老人遣散，火渐渐熄灭，老人范阳引顾余生走进山洞里的一条坎儿井，在狭窄的通道里，老人步履矫健：“我知小友是修行之人，有一颗炽热的心，但我的族人们如今最需要的，是如何生存活下去，保持子嗣的繁衍，时局如迷，更需要的是忍耐，冒犯之处，还请小友原谅。”
顾余生点头道：“老人家，我会帮你们清除掉周围的妖兽，等开春后，就可以放心种庄稼，天亮之后我就要往万妖城，你们切切保重，一定会有春暖花开日的。”
“小友，你是背剑人吗？”
范阳停下脚步，他站在坎儿井与内洞交界处，侧面还有一个隐秘通道，应该是用来保全族人的。
“老人家何以知晓？”
“十多年前，我见过一位背剑人，你们有着一样悲天悯人的眼神，”范阳抬起头，眺望山崖上方的洞，正值雪停，露出点点星空，他回过头来，目光不再混浊，“大荒里生存的人，祖辈都曾追随过一位顶天立地之人，可惜，他已经消失在历史的长河里，他对我们的先祖说过，世界不会一直黑暗，终会迎来光明。”
顾余生不由地想起在天地大墓里看见的那一尊背影，为此深信不疑：“我也相信。”
范阳沉默片刻，说道：“万妖城那边有我们人族留下的遗产，小友若有机缘，不妨寻一寻。”
“在下记住了。”
顾余生拱手，他进入到崖洞里面一间透气而安静的房间里，淳朴的女人们生怕他被冻着，在石床上铺一层厚厚的稻草，在上面铺上两张厚实的兽皮。
顾余生在大荒雪里行，裹兽皮在肩头，轻轻低头，就可以把整个头埋进温暖里，他强忍着这般享乐，待整个山洞安静后，他取出数张符纸，吹一口灵气，化作一个个提剑的扎纸人飞出洞外，仅仅两个时辰，就将方圆百里之地强大的妖兽抹杀，并在田亩之地卖下几道隐秘剑气。
做完这一切，顾余生又默默参悟了一会铁券上的文字，与古鼎内的文字结合，略微花了一些时间，虽然没有开辟出一条完整的经脉，却也打通两个隐穴，使得他对天地间灵气的依赖再一次降低。
天还未彻亮，顾余生轻轻摩挲着毛茸茸的兽皮，又想起那些几近光溜的孩子，在离开前，留了几张更大的兽皮，将几瓶修行初期的丹药留在房间，在墙上留下几道入门剑意。

一道遁光微起，在星月下向西而行。
顾余生离开时，没有打扰任何人，但在坎儿井的崖前，范阳老人拄着拐杖，在风雪里目送。
数日时间匆匆过，大荒深处的雪，比十六州还要大数倍，苍茫天地，厚雪冰棱阻断山川古道，万鸟绝迹，人烟杳杳。
在这样的极寒之下，能够活动的只有实力强悍的大妖，即便是人族元婴修士至此，也是危险重重，九死一生。
万妖城盘踞在临江的上游，整座古城建在绵绵起伏的群山之中，山谷之地，良田万顷，群山之外平阔千里。
这是人族先祖留下的生存之地，千年岁月，万妖城虽为妖族所侵占，万族林立，可万妖城及周边，生活着百万人族。
妖族之地，当然不可能有王朝建立，而是以族群部落划分，生活在这里的凡人，尊奉部落之主，以酋长，祭司为尊，实际上就是妖族掌控人族的一种手段。
三千年前，剑王朝鼎盛之时，有十万剑修入大荒，彼时的妖族和人族之间，有着特殊的‘蜜月’期，那时生活在天妖城，万妖城的人族反而比人族十六州的人幸福。
世事移转，千年前小夫子如一颗璀璨流星出现，让野心勃勃的妖族不得不继续遵守契约。
如今，人族两盟已无，通往太乙大门的天路已开，受天道影响，人族修行者境界跌落者众，妖族又有妖圣陨落，剧烈的冲突，终究波及到了凡人的头上。
数月前，万妖城之主，是惊鲵妖圣，惊鲵作为大荒战力第一的妖圣，完全可以掌控这座万年古城。
可是，天地神树之行，惊鲵妖圣遭遇连番变故，先被和尚空海收进钵盂，又被三魂殿追捕，生死不明，万妖城内的妖族强者，早已将妖圣视为已死，蠢蠢欲动。
窃夺万妖城最好的办法，就是掌控人族，因为人族尊奉的酋长，祭司等等，实则与大梵天圣地佛宗的香火之念差不多，妖族能够通过人族的信仰获得修行的捷径，这是掩藏在敕封之力外的隐秘。
万妖城妖族势力盘踞，他们争夺的方式，比人族更直接，更血腥，正面的厮杀，赢者获得一切，栖居的人族成为战利品，在极寒的天气里被赶出屋子，迁居妖族领地，在这个过程中，一场场灾难降临到人族头上。
还隔着百里，顾余生就感觉到万妖城方向传来的血腥气，恐怖的妖潮在山林雪地里如狂浪奔腾，妖族已大乱，各方都在城内城外厮杀，妖族族群之间的战斗，少的一方也有数千，多的一方则上万，甚至数十万。
妖修可以驭妖兽，妖兽可以号令更多妖兽，当妖族之间的战斗演变成妖潮之乱，只有一方彻底消亡才会终止。
万妖城外平阔深林，妖兽尸骸堆积如山，一旦开春，温度上升，真正的灾难还会延续，顾余生虽料到万妖城已乱，但没想到会乱到如此程度。
铅灰的天空，天禽类的妖族遮天蔽日，振翅万丈，爪击嘴喙，飘落的雪花染血。
远远看去，建立在群山之上的万妖城天空，有无数的黑点坠落，那不是雪花，而是飞禽坠落的尸骸。
千年大荒，妖族实力的增长，远远超过人族，物竞天择，丛林法则，数十万里大荒，才是真正的蛮荒世界。

顾余生停在孤山之上，目睹前方发生的妖族之战，头皮发麻。
content_en:
Gu Yusheng was greatly shaken, but he tried his best to control his heart. After remembering all the contents, he returned the iron certificate as usual.
Gu Yusheng wanted to ask something else, but he stopped talking. He was just a passerby. It would be bad if he brought disaster to this small village.
However, since he had received such a great opportunity, he had to express something. After eating, Gu Yusheng said: "Old man, it's difficult to travel at night. I'm afraid I'll have to bother you all night."
"My little friend, you don't mind being shabby, just feel free to stay here."
Hearing that Gu Yusheng was going to stay overnight, several women hurriedly went back and discussed how to pack up a room for Gu Yusheng to live in. Gu Yusheng gathered around the fire pond and chatted about some folklore in Qingping Prefecture. He occasionally exchanged ideas with other people about how to grow crops, and taught these people the seasonal grain method that he and Mo Wanyun learned when they were in Xixin Village. As for how much they can listen to, it depends on their luck.
Through small talk, Gu Yusheng also learned that it was not that there were no human races living in the depths of the wilderness, but that they had been reduced to pieces over the long years. People from several races like them lived in relatively safe places, where men farmed and women weaved, and hunted for a living.
As the night progressed, the women left with their children, while the strong men were still curious about the outside world. Gu Yusheng almost couldn't help telling him the fact of his identity as a practitioner several times, but the old man stopped him with his eyes.
Until the men were dismissed by the old man and the fire gradually extinguished, the old man Fan Yang led Gu Yusheng into a karez in the cave. In the narrow passage, the old man walked vigorously: "I know that my little friend is a practitioner and has a fiery heart. But what my people need most now is how to survive and maintain the reproduction of their heirs. The current situation is confusing, and what is more needed is patience. If I have offended, please forgive me."
Gu Yusheng nodded and said: "Old man, I will help you get rid of the monsters around you. When spring starts, you can plant crops with confidence. I will go to the City of Ten Thousand Monsters after dawn. You must take care of yourself. There will be a warm spring and flowers will bloom."
"My little friend, are you a sword bearer?"
Fan Yang stopped. He stood at the junction of the karez and the inner cave. There was a secret passage on the side, which should be used to protect the clan members.
"How does the old man know?"
"More than ten years ago, I saw a man carrying a sword, and you have the same compassionate eyes." Fan Yang raised his head and looked at the hole above the cliff. The snow stopped, revealing the starry sky. He turned back, his eyes no longer cloudy. "The ancestors of people living in the wilderness have followed a man who stood upright. Unfortunately, he has disappeared in the long river of history. He said to our ancestors that the world will not always be dark, but will eventually usher in light."
Gu Yusheng couldn't help but think of the back figure he saw in the Tomb of Heaven and Earth, and he believed it deeply: "I believe it too."
Fan Yang was silent for a moment and said: "There is a legacy left by our human race over there in Ten Thousand Monsters City. If you have a chance, you might as well look for it."
"I'll remember it."
Gu Yusheng handed over his hand and entered a breathable and quiet room inside the cliff cave. The simple women were afraid that he would be frozen, so they spread a thick layer of straw on the stone bed and two thick animal skins on top.
Gu Yusheng walked in the snow in the wilderness, wrapping the animal skin on his shoulders, lowering his head gently, and burying his whole head in the warmth. He endured this enjoyment. After the whole cave was quiet, he took out several talismans, blew a breath of spiritual energy, and transformed into paper-making figures with swords and flew out of the cave. In just two hours, he wiped out the powerful monsters within a hundred miles and sold several hidden sword energy in acres of land.
After doing all this, Gu Yusheng silently studied the words on the iron certificate for a while, and combined it with the words in the ancient cauldron. It took some time. Although he did not open up a complete meridian, he also opened up two hidden points, which once again reduced his dependence on the spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
It's not clear yetIt was bright, Gu Yusheng gently rubbed the furry animal skin, and thought of those almost naked children. Before leaving, he left a few larger animal skins, a few bottles of elixirs from the early stages of cultivation in the room, and a few entry sword intentions on the wall.
A ray of light rose slightly, heading west under the stars and moon.
When Gu Yusheng left, he did not disturb anyone, but in front of the cliff of the karez, old man Fan Yang watched him off in the wind and snow, leaning on his cane.
A few days passed quickly, and the snow in the depths of the wilderness was several times heavier than that in the Sixteenth Prefecture. The vast world was covered with thick snow and ice blocking the ancient mountain roads. Thousands of birds were extinct, and the human population was completely deserted.
Under such extreme cold, only the powerful demons can move. Even the human Nascent Soul monks are in danger and have a narrow escape.
Wanyao City is entrenched in the upper reaches of Linjiang River. The entire ancient city is built among the rolling mountains. In the valley, there are thousands of hectares of fertile farmland, and beyond the mountains, it is thousands of miles wide.
This is the place of survival left by the ancestors of the human race. For thousands of years, the City of Ten Thousand Demons has been occupied by the demon tribe and there are thousands of races, but there are millions of human races living in the City of Ten Thousand Demons and its surroundings.
Of course, it is impossible to establish a dynasty in the land of the demon clan. Instead, it is divided by ethnic groups and tribes. The mortals living here respect the master of the tribe, the chief, and the priest. This is actually a means for the demon clan to control the human race.
Three thousand years ago, when the Sword Dynasty was at its peak, hundreds of thousands of sword cultivators entered the wilderness. At that time, there was a special "honeymoon" period between the demon race and the human race. At that time, the humans living in Tianyao City and Ten Thousand Demon City were happier than the people in the sixteen states of the human race.
Things changed, and the young master appeared like a bright meteor thousands of years ago, forcing the ambitious demon clan to continue to abide by the contract.
Nowadays, the two alliances of the human race are gone, and the heavenly road to the gate of Taiyi has been opened. Under the influence of heaven, many human cultivators have fallen into decline, and demon saints have fallen from the demon race. The fierce conflict has finally affected the mortals.
A few months ago, the Lord of Ten Thousand Demons City was Jing Salamander Demon Saint. As the most powerful demon saint in the wilderness, Jing Salamander could completely control this ten thousand year old city.
However, during the trip to the sacred tree of heaven and earth, the Jing Salamander Demon Saint encountered a series of changes. He was first taken into the alms bowl by the monk Kukai, and then hunted down by the Three Souls Palace. His life and death were unknown. The strong demon clan in the Ten Thousand Demon City had already regarded the Demon Saint as dead and was ready to take action.
The best way to steal the City of Ten Thousand Demons is to control the human race, because the chiefs, priests, etc. respected by the human race are actually similar to the incense of the Buddhist sect in the Holy Land of Brahma. The demon race can obtain shortcuts to practice through the faith of the human race. This is a secret hidden outside the power of the imperial edict.
The demonic forces in Ten Thousand Demonic City are entrenched. Their method of fighting is more direct and bloody than that of the human race. It is a head-on fight. The winner gets everything. The humans who live there become spoils of war. They are driven out of their houses in the extremely cold weather and move to the demonic territory. In the process, one disaster after another befalls the human race.
Still hundreds of miles away, Gu Yusheng felt the bloody smell coming from the direction of Ten Thousand Demons City. The terrifying demon tide was rushing like wild waves in the mountains, forests and snow. The demon clan was in chaos. All parties were fighting inside and outside the city. The battles between the demon clans included thousands, and tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands, of the demon clans.
Demon cultivators can control demon beasts, and demon beasts can command more demon beasts. When the battle between demon clans evolves into a demon tide, it will only end if one party dies completely.
Outside the City of Ten Thousand Demons, there are vast and deep forests, and the corpses of monsters pile up like mountains. Once spring starts and the temperature rises, the real disaster will continue. Although Gu Yusheng expected that the City of Ten Thousand Demons would be in chaos, he did not expect that the chaos would reach such an extent.
In the leaden sky, the demon clan of celestial birds covered the sky and blocked out the sun. They flapped their wings and struck their beaks with their claws. The falling snowflakes were stained with blood.
Looking from a distance, there are countless black spots falling in the sky of Ten Thousand Monsters City built on the mountains. They are not snowflakes, but the corpses of fallen birds.
In the millennium of wilderness, the strength of the demon clan has grown far beyond that of the human race. Natural selection, the law of the jungle, and hundreds of thousands of miles of wilderness,This is the real wild world.
Gu Yusheng stopped on the lonely mountain and saw the battle between the monsters ahead. His scalp went numb.
